name: firecrawl-redis
description: Redis is an in-memory data store used by Firecrawl for caching, session rate limiting and queue-related data. Uses the official Redis Docker image. Configuration /mnt/user/appdata/firecrawl/redis Persistent Redis data storage. Redis Port 6379 Internal Redis connection port. Firecrawl connects to Redis through the firecrawl Docker network. No host port is required.
